description: Copy-in CI recipes for adding macOS build/test/lint to a project on the ios profile — either a macOS-only app with no iOS target, or a hybrid app that also ships a separate macOS scheme sharing code with an iOS target. Use when scaffolding CI for a new macOS app, or adding a macOS target/scheme to an existing iOS project. The lacquer does not auto-sync macOS CI (only two fleet projects have needed it so far — not enough signal to justify conditional asset sync yet); these are reference recipes you copy into your project's own workflow files, adapted from two real, working implementations (a macOS-only app and an iOS+macOS hybrid).
